sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: All for the Show - Pyrotechnics is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Ever play baseball? You know how to blow the crowd away? With a good throw of a grenade! Not literally into the stands, of course. Try that and I'll have you feeding the fish. But when someone gets turned into mush by a grenade in the Arena, the crowd screams louder than the blast itself!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Win a match on Fort
- Win a match on Equator
- Win a match on Bowl
- Win a match on Chop Shop
- Win a match on Bay 5

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +7,000 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.01
- 56,000 Roubles
- 50 GP coins
- 1× Lega Medal

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Kills that happen after the player's death do not count.
